statusDetail: Cloudflare bot-management returned HTTP 403 with cf-mitigated: challenge. Raw CDP remained on “Performing security verification” after a second 15-second attempt, so the origin page and representative routes could not be reached.

page.notes: Only Cloudflare’s managed challenge document was observable; it is not treated as the site under audit.

artifacts.caption: Initial raw-CDP view shows Cloudflare security verification instead of site content.
Second raw-CDP view after 15 seconds still shows the verification wall.
DOM and CSS belong to the Cloudflare managed challenge, confirming the origin surface was unavailable.
Recon probe returned title “Just a moment...” and only Cloudflare links.
Site-file probe observed robots.txt but sitemap.xml returned 403.
Atomic 58-check manifest with per-check evidence plans.
